title: Living Together Is Replacing Marriage Across Generations
hook: Marriage stopped being the automatic first step for couples.
closing: Cohabitation is no longer a young-adult detour; it is reshaping partnership across generations.
question: Would you live together before marrying?

segments.say: Among the youngest adults, 9 percent live with an unmarried partner, more than live with a spouse.
Only 40 percent of adults in their late twenties and early thirties now live with a spouse.
Cohabiting adults over fifty reached 4.2 million, showing the shift now spans generations.
